usage.callShape: GET https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com/x402/v3/cryptocurrency/quotes/latest?symbol=BTC (or ?slug=bitcoin or ?id=1). Params go in the URL query string; no JSON body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base.
usage.outputShape: body.data[] is an array of matching coins; price at body.data[i].quote[0].price (USD), with body.data[i].quote[0].percent_change_24h, .market_cap, .volume_24h. Coin identity at body.data[i].id/name/symbol/slug/cmc_rank. body.status.credit_count = credits used.
quirks: Params are query-string on a GET, not a JSON body.

Querying by symbol returns ALL tokens sharing that ticker (symbol=BTC returned 14 entries; real Bitcoin is the one with id=1 / slug=bitcoin / cmc_rank=1). For a precise single-token result query by slug (e.g. slug=bitcoin) or by CMC id (e.g. id=1) instead.
Must supply at least one of id / slug / symbol or the call has no target.
txHash not surfaced by the payment layer (confirmed=false) but the call did settle and return 200 with live data.
Pricing defaults to USD; pass convert=EUR,JPY etc. for other quote currencies (each adds a quote object under data[].quote).
usage.guide: Call GET https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com/x402/v3/cryptocurrency/quotes/latest with the coin selector as a URL query param: prefer slug (e.g. ?slug=bitcoin) or id (e.g. ?id=1) for an unambiguous single result, since ?symbol=BTC returns every token using that ticker. The wallet auto-pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base; no API key needed. Read the price from body.data[0].quote[0].price (USD) and 24h change from body.data[0].quote[0].percent_change_24h. To match a coin from a symbol result, pick the entry with the matching slug/id (real Bitcoin = id 1, slug bitcoin, cmc_rank 1). Add convert=EUR (etc.) to get other fiat quotes.
